title: Quiet Student Preview Marker
lede: The Admin presenting in Student view needs a persistent cue that stays visible without competing with the content. The preview now reads as a quiet mode marker, while the real exit action remains in Settings.

stats.n: The full-width orange preview pill no longer consumes the top of the screen
A non-interactive orange edge stroke remains persistent around the screen

sections.heading: Side by side
sections.note: Same iPhone 16 Pro simulator, same DEBUG fixture, same Guides surface. The clock advanced naturally between captures; the only intentional change is the preview chrome.

pairs.title: Student preview on Guides
pairs.sub: The content stays in place while the mode cue becomes quieter.
pairs.beforeCap: The preview was presented as a full-width warning pill with a prominent Exit action, using roughly 44 points of vertical space and obscuring the Guides header.
pairs.afterCap: The warning pill is gone. A thin orange frame preserves the persistent Student-preview cue, and the Guides header is unobstructed.

changes.h: Preview status is now ambient context
changes.was: The orange preview banner looked and behaved like an urgent warning, including an in-banner exit action.
changes.now: The preview uses a one-point orange screen-edge accent with no hit target. This leaves network and error banners unchanged and keeps the exit control discoverable in Settings → Presentation.

verification: Focused native source-contract tests pass, including the quiet marker and Settings-only exit contract.
Wisconsin Debug build succeeds for the configured iPhone 16 Pro simulator on iOS 26.5.
Matched fixture UI captures pass under the WisconsinPerformance scheme and were inspected at full resolution.
notes: The active preview still ends from Settings → Presentation → Exit Student preview; the edge marker is deliberately non-interactive.
This review proves the native fixture surface and build. It does not claim a fresh authenticated physical-iPhone acceptance run or a deployment.
